summary: Remediated src/content/blog/beginner/is-palmistry-real.md per Director review: removed the unsupported claim that studies comparing life-line length to recorded lifespan find no consistent relationship (body and FAQ, two occurrences), replacing it with the repository-approved general statements already established in foundations/01-what-palmistry-is.mdx and beginner/what-palmistry-is.md (no scientific support for occult predictive meaning; no palmistry tradition validated as reliably predictive under controlled conditions), applied explicitly to the article's own historical examples (Cheiro, Benham, Varahamihira). Narrowed the unsupported 'practiced continuously, in several independent forms, for centuries' claim to 'practiced in distinct forms across multiple cultures for centuries', dropping the unsupported continuity assertion (the approved West-tradition history notes a medieval suppression period, i.e. not continuous) while keeping the multi-culture framing, which is directly supported by what-palmistry-is.md's approved India/China/West independent-development language elsewhere in this same article. No canonical docs required changes: reviewed docs/editorial-backlog.md, docs/CHANGELOG.md, docs/CURRENT_STATE.md, and docs/AI_HANDOFF.md's revision-1 additions and confirmed none repeat the two flagged claims, so no doc churn was made per the task packet's explicit scope limit. Reused PR #36 rather than opening a second PR, pushing the fix to the existing claude/relay-PP-RELAY-021-is-palmistry-real branch.
